local_top_level_names adds every module stem under imas_ambix/, tests/ and scripts/ as a local name, so a third-party top-level module sharing a stem with any local file would be masked rather than classified. No collision is evident in the current census, and the cost of one is a silently missed declaration; a targeted test would make the assumption explicit.
